Hi all —

Attached the initial deployment-options-diagram.png and a short note below as promised. I also updated the acme-ssq-initial.xlsx with suggested evidence mappings for the controls we can address immediately.

Quick technical summary (high level):

1) Hosted (standard Redwood API):
   - Multi-tenant hosting with encryption in transit and at rest, key management via customer KMS (when requested), prefix caching. Not suitable for HIPAA unless additional agreements are in place.

2) Dedicated (VPC) — Recommended for Acme pilot:
   - Isolated GPU pool per customer, VPC peering or PrivateLink depending on cloud provider.
   - No public IP on serving instances; control plane in Redwood-managed network with restricted control-plane egress.
   - SOC 2 controls mapped for network segmentation and access logging.

3) Private / On‑prem (air-gapped option):
   - Full private deployment inside customer network or air-gapped cluster. Model artifacts and updates can be delivered via signed bundles (SHA256 + PKI) or secure offline transfer (SFTP behind firewall) per customer policy.
   - For model updates we support:
       a) Signed artifact install (recommended): Redwood produces signed, versioned model bundle; customer operator pulls via removable media or SFTP and verifies signature before install.
       b) Controlled push via temporary private network link established for the update window (requires joint ops coordination).
   - We can produce a formal BAA for Private deployments; will need legal review but we have standard clauses used with other customers.

Attachments: deployment-options-diagram.png (contains: Dedicated VPC diagram, VPC peering flow, on‑prem air‑gapped layout with update paths), updated acme-ssq-initial.xlsx (control mappings), redwood-security-brief.pdf

Next steps:

- We'll finalize diagrams and a short control-evidence package prior to the call.
